summaryZh: CASE Lab研究触觉如何被体验为愉悦或疼痛，以及情感性触摸和压力如何调节急性与慢性疼痛。实验室结合认知与情感神经科学，使用经颅磁刺激、fMRI、心理物理学测试及纳洛酮阻断阿片受体，研究触觉情感成分的脑通路与调控。
researchQuestions: 情感性触摸和压力如何调节急性与慢性疼痛？
topics: 触觉感知的脑通路及阿片调控
methods: 纳洛酮阿片受体药理阻断

evidence.quote: Dr. Case’s NIH-funded research uses brain imaging, pharmacologic manipulation, and sensory and behavioral testing to evaluate neural and psychological mechanisms involved in affective touch and pain perception.
CASE LAB Our Team Principal Investigator Laura Case PhD
Dr. Case is an Associate Professor in the Department of Anesthesiology at UC San Diego.
CASE Lab is located in the Department of Anesthesiology at UC San Diego.
We have used transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS), fMRI, and psychophysical testing
Using pharmacologic blockade of opioid receptors by naloxone
Our current research examines the modulatory effects of affective touch and pressure on perception of acute and chronic pain.
